# CPDataKit v0.8.0

2026-09-08

- NetCDF, Zarr and HDF5 2.0 apply field, record and dimension selection before loading arrays.
  Parquet skips unrelated row groups. A separate-process benchmark records read time and peak memory.
- Heatmaps display scientific slices and export PNGs with units and slice coordinates.
- Python, CLI and workbench users can draft schemas and preview mappings. Mapping 2.0 handles
  dimension renaming and axis ordering.
- Batch conversion validates each file and checks output conflicts before writing.
  Progress goes into an atomic manifest. Retries use the recorded parameters and hashes.
- Jobs report progress and respond to cancellation at checkpoints. Workbench output promotion,
  catalog registration and rollback run in a serialized section within one process, so completed
  outputs retain their recorded state even when a cancellation request arrives later.
- The licensed KupferDigital/FE bundle contains 483 experiment-derived and 729 training rows.
  Conversion preserves hashes, case splits and the 0–0.8% strain scope.
- Runtime requirements are h5py >=3.11, Pint >=0.24.4 and netCDF4 >=1.7.2, following reproduced
  NumPy 2 import incompatibilities and a classic NetCDF read failure.
- Dependency jobs test pinned lower combinations and the latest supported versions using installed wheels.

Python >=3.12 is required. The v0.5 public API/CLI, schema 1.0, default tabular HDF5 1.0 and
v0.7 behaviors remain supported. Scientific data continues to use schema/HDF5 2.0.
Code is Apache-2.0, and the attributed reference materials are CC-BY-4.0.

Local candidate results are recorded in [the P0 report](https://github.com/koocmitwho/cpdatakit/blob/v0.8.0/docs/verification/2026-09-08-v080-p0.md).
Hosted CI results are available on the release pull request.
